## Predictions

- Windows tried: 30 days, 60 days, 90 days; each must pass the gate at 96.7% confidence, corrected for trying 3.
- A model to predict whether Fail happens within 30 days was promoted. On 5,439 held-out entities the model ranks outcomes with AUC 0.813, against 0.698 for the baseline rule. At 97% confidence the gain is between +0.077 and +0.161 (AUC). It was also checked in 3 segments (history length) and is not clearly worse than the baseline rule in any of them. Inputs added by the search (12 tried): time since the last Fail with risk Risk 3 (Low); the tuned model was kept.
- A model to predict whether Fail happens within 60 days was promoted. On 5,421 held-out entities the model ranks outcomes with AUC 0.822, against 0.703 for the baseline rule. At 97% confidence the gain is between +0.089 and +0.145 (AUC). It was also checked in 3 segments (history length) and is not clearly worse than the baseline rule in any of them. None of the 12 candidate inputs the search tried improved it.
- A model to predict whether Fail happens within 90 days was promoted. On 5,387 held-out entities the model ranks outcomes with AUC 0.809, against 0.692 for the baseline rule. At 97% confidence the gain is between +0.094 and +0.141 (AUC). It was also checked in 3 segments (history length) and is not clearly worse than the baseline rule in any of them. None of the 12 candidate inputs the search tried improved it.
